definitions.explanation: A formal speech of farewell, above all the one a current student reads to the graduating class at a Japanese graduation ceremony. The graduates' reply is the {答辞|とうじ}.

examples.japanese: {送辞|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
{在校生代表|ざいこうせいだいひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{送辞|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: A representative of the current students gave the farewell address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{送辞|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれて→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧、⟦{緊張|きんちょう}している→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: I've been chosen to read the farewell address at the graduation ceremony, and I'm nervous.

notes:
{送|そう} (send off) + {辞|じ} (words). A formal word, heard mostly at graduation ceremonies and at farewells for people leaving a post.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送辞|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the farewell address
- {送辞|そうじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to deliver the farewell address
- {在校生代表|ざいこうせいだいひょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{送辞|そうじ}: the farewell address on behalf of the current students

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{答辞|とうじ}→答辞：31889_touji⟧: the graduates' reply to the {送辞|そうじ}
- ⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧: congratulatory speech, given by guests
